question: For working-age adults on sick leave due to common mental disorders, how do work-directed interventions affect return to work and related outcomes?
eligibility: Working-age adults (18-64) on sick leave because of mild to moderate depression, anxiety, adjustment disorders, or reactions to severe stress.
Interventions involving the workplace or employer representative.
Comparator may be absent, usual care, or another intervention.
Outcomes include return to work, sick-leave days, or income.
as_of_source: Day after latest Entrez date among included PubMed records (lower bound; source review covered records published 2015-2021).
source: Fisker et al. 2024, Effects of work-directed interventions on return-to-work in people on sick-leave for common mental disorders. PMID 38710801; PMCID PMC11245426. https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11245426/
notes: All 11 included articles (8 RCTs) resolved to PubMed PMIDs.
